# unifi_site_to_site_tunnel (Data Source)

Retrieves a site-to-site VPN tunnel via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Site-to-site tunnels are read-only on the Official API. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_site_to_site_tunnel" "branch" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the site-to-site VPN tunnel to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The full tunnel overview, including type-specific fields, serialized as a JSON string.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the tunnel entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`, `DERIVED`).
- `name` (String) The name of the site-to-site VPN tunnel.
- `type` (String) The tunnel type (e.g. `IPSEC`, `OPENVPN`, `WIREGUARD`).
